title: A video window says its name, size, length and whether it is saved in its title bar
goal: The video mocks put one quiet line in the title bar: the project name in bold, the picture size, the length, and saved or edited, so a person always knows which edit they are in and whether closing will lose anything. The app shows none of that today, which matters more now that an edit can be saved as a named project.
notes: Found in the side-by-side for a-video-edit-can-be-saved-as-a-project-and-opene (2026-09-24). Mock spec: docs/design/mocks/shared/AGENTS.md ~line 452 (data-shell: text before the first dot is bolded) and data-shell on video.html, video-captions.html (capDirty) and video-audio.html (aDirty). App today: the title bar shows the traffic lights and the Everything mode picker, no document name (see /tmp/photonz-playtest/a-video-edit-saves-as-a-project-walk/9-reopened-sc.png). Readable state: EditorState.windowTitle, hasUnsavedChanges, documentLengthMS, document.canvasSize.
acceptance: At Next defaults, an opened recording shows its file name, picture size and length in the title bar, as video.html draws it (launch-teaser · 1920 x 1080 · 0:15 · saved)
After a cut the line says edited, and after File > Save As it shows the project name and saved
The line sits where the mock puts it and in the mock type weight and colour (name bold, the rest faint), with no new control added to the title bar
A walk at Next defaults photographs the line before and after a save, and the audit sets it beside the video.html title bar

log.note: Review before building: a Premiere or Final Cut editor reads the project name from the window title, so the line belongs centred in the title bar like a Mac title; the mock draws it that way (video.html data-shell, .wtitle: name ink bold, rest dim, saved faint, edited warn per video-captions.html). No gap between mock and app state: name, canvas size, length and SaveAffordance already existed. The line takes no clicks and adds no control.

Built: PhotonzCore/WindowTitleLine.swift (tested, WindowTitleLineTests) makes the words; EditorState.titleLine feeds it only for documents with time; Photonz/TitlebarDocumentLine.swift draws it over the top of EditorView, centred, 33pt strip measured level with the mode chip, dropping size and length before the name on a narrow window, hidden in full screen. Saved means SaveAffordance.upToDate, so the line says edited exactly when closing would ask. Length rounds down like the transport's end.

Verified: a-video-window-says-its-name-walk at Next defaults (no flags) reads 'Tutorial Sample · 1280 x 800 · 0:08 · saved', then '· edited' after Command K, then 'project · 1280 x 800 · 0:08 · saved' after Command S, and no line on a still picture; 3 real window captures. command-s-saves-a-video-project-walk still passes. Scripts/test.sh: 10025 tests pass (one pre-existing speech skip).

Left rough, not filed: mock's Ask button in the title bar (agent work, not this task); pictures get no line though image mocks draw name and size (a scope question, asked in the audit's evaluate list); full-screen hiding built but not watched live. Shared EditorView: the line only shows for documents with time, the same gate the timeline dock uses, so Current's pictures are unchanged.

Video windows show name · W x H · length · saved/edited centred in the title bar as video.html draws it (WindowTitleLine in PhotonzCore, TitlebarDocumentLine in the app). Verified by a-video-window-says-its-name-walk at Next defaults (saved, edited after Command K, project name + saved after Command S, no line on a picture, 3 real captures), full test suite green, audit queue/audits/2026-09-27-video-title-line.json with the mock side by side.
